snippet.title: Pikmin 2: Yellow Edition (by Captain Salty) (Pikhacks week Day 6)
snippet.description:
In case you cant tell by the very different production value of this trailer, this hack is actually from my good friend Captain Salty, who I helped greatly in making this. The trailer itself was edited by wigwamman7, who clearly put a lot more time into this than I ever do. Regardless, we agreed to have it be part of my pikhacks week so that I can actually fill all 7 days.
You can see Salty's youtube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCR6I0FphqtkUDuX9LSqhLzg

Pikmin 2: Yellow Edition is a hack made by Captain Salty. You are given only Yellow Pikmin and for the majority of the hack, they are the only type you will have at your disposal. To up the stakes, onions have been removed, so your options to make more Pikmin are severely limited. Are you up to the challenge of completing the game with arguably the worst Pikmin type?

Tomorrow will be the last day of this project, I hope you guys have enjoyed it so far!

Download the hack here on his website: https://captainsaltythesaltshaker.itch.io/pikmin-2-yellow-edition

I would recommend you join my server to discuss this hack or if you need help, I can hopefully help answer questions as much as him.
https://discord.gg/WHSaSS5
